result:
The nightly-2026-09-26 release now has one plain-language line per merged emulator change, and the generator that writes the notes is changed to produce the same format every night. PR #400 is marked ready; CI on its head (`321bba0d50`) had not finished yet.

**What the release says now** (updated in place with the REST API and read back; the APK, tag and title are unchanged):
- **Performance:** Grabbed by the Ghoulies no longer slows to 2 fps after a few minutes; it holds about 29 fps on handhelds (#311).
- **Stability:** Games whose vertex programs write to constant registers no longer abort (#233).
- **Rendering fixes:** 21 lines, such as "The far part of floors and walls drawn with a 24-bit depth buffer no longer goes missing (#266)".
- **Other:** 3 lines.
- Then one line, "Plus internal test-harness work.", and the kept install line, ES-DE line and build sha, ending with `_Notes updated … UTC._`.

The 54 lane commits, the harness and docs sections and the 563-commit count are gone. Of the 32 merged PRs that changed emulator code, 6 are left out on purpose: four are off-by-default instrumentation, prototypes or probes; one adds a helper nothing calls yet; and #244 is covered by #222's line. The full body is quoted in the PR.

**How the generator works now** (`nightly_build.sh`; the build steps are untouched):
- **What counts:** only merged PRs since the previous nightly, each judged by its net change to master. A change reverted inside its own PR (the #315 BRDF case) has no net change and isn't listed. A PR that is merged and then reverted in the same window drops out with its revert.
- **Where each line comes from:** a row in a hand-written table, `docs/lanes/nightlynotes/release_notes.tsv`, first. Otherwise a `Release note (<category>): <line>` line in the PR's description. Otherwise the PR title with the lane prefix and trailing notes stripped.
- **Internal words:** a line that still contains words like arm, lane, audit or probe is not printed; the change appears only as its number under Other.

**Something to decide:** none of the PRs in this window had a `Release note:` line, so I wrote all 26 lines by hand into that table. Without it, the fallback for future nights is PR titles: they contain no internal words, but they read like "nv2a/vsh: R12 reads the original oPos after a paired MAC+ILU write (#280)", not player language. To fix that, AGENTS.md should ask every PR that changes emulator code for a `Release note:` line. AGENTS.md isn't among the files this lane may edit, so that needs a separate change.

**Testing:**
- **Fragment 86:** I rewrote `86-nightly-notes.sh` with test repos covering every case in the brief, and it passes together with fragment 87: 93 of 93 checks.
- **Replaced generator:** run over the same test repo, it lists the trace and scaffolding commits and fails the new "no internal words" check.
- **Broken generator copies:** five deliberately broken copies of the new one each fail at least one check.
- **Preflight:** passes with `--allow-tracker`.
- **Full selftest:** I did not finish it locally. It was still in fragment 40 of about 99 after roughly 15 minutes, so I stopped it; CI's run is the gate.

What changed, the numbers and advice for the next lane are in `docs/lanes/nightlynotes/NOTES.md` §5.
